robsnyder.en: Demand is a project someone must act on now, not a pain point; test it by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: 需求不是痛点，而是某人当下必须推进的项目；用对方是否立刻尝试购买来检验。

robsnyder.en: Skip design partners and pilots; sell directly to one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case-study factory.
robsnyder.zh: 跳过设计伙伴和试点，直接卖给一个“绝对要”的客户，再打造可复制案例工厂。

robsnyder.en: Sales is research: purchase is the truth-seeking mechanism that interviews and feedback lack.
robsnyder.zh: 销售即研究：购买才是访谈与反馈所缺的求真机制。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba and observe where people are stuck; avoid error-prone customer interviews.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场观察人们卡在哪里，避免易出错的客户访谈。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; make the product seem small.
robsnyder.zh: 技术放最后：先以服务形式售卖，需求验证后再自动化；让产品显得小而非大。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、声音与专业能力更重要，而人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, and the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们已进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation is a paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts matter more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托存在悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此专家比以往更重要。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI lowers organizing costs and creates more work worth attempting.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 参差不齐的能力边界与采用滞后使人类仍不可或缺；更多 AI 降低组织成本，创造更多值得尝试的工作。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not a crutch; wide knowledge, deep expertise, taste, and agency remain human advantages.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当作挑战你的导师而非拐杖；广博知识、深厚专业、品味与能动性仍是人类优势。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers shift from executors to editors: AI handles execution while human judgment curates quality and sets the bar.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师从执行者转为编辑者：AI 负责执行，人类判断负责筛选质量、设定标准。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents; expose parameters to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 把复杂任务拆成子任务，迭代地交给 AI 智能体；暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, committing pull requests, not just design in Figma.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应学会用代码构建与测试、提交 pull request，而不只是在 Figma 里做设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: With AI accelerating execution, ideas become the limiting factor; less is more—reduce to top three features and use native scroll.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 加速执行后，想法成为限制因素；少即是多——精简到前三个功能，并用原生滚动。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use now surpasses average humans at most tasks; the next frontier is superhuman speed, with agents operating all human-designed software.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，计算机使用在多数任务上已超过普通人，下一个前沿是超人速度；智能体能操作所有人类设计的软件，实现通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: Accessibility trees and DOM access beat screenshot-scroll loops; computer use lets agents test their own code, completing the dev lifecycle.
ariweinstein.zh: 可访问性树和 DOM 访问优于截图滚动循环；计算机使用让智能体测试自己的代码，补全开发全流程。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence; models debug and retry autonomously rather than just starting tasks then failing.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向网站加载时间；模型能自主调试和重试，而非只启动任务然后失败。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprises need deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials; proactivity means agents adapt to users, reducing adoption friction.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节；主动性意味着智能体适应用户，降低采用摩擦。

ariweinstein.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise; legacy software coexists and improves, and startups keep a moat in deep expertise.
ariweinstein.zh: 计算机使用在消费端和企业端同时进入 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻；传统软件共存并改进，初创公司在深度专业领域仍有护城河。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines all of Alphabet; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube drives 24% revenue growth and record Cloud backlog.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 全部业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube，带来 24% 营收增长和创纪录的云业务订单储备。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI and frontier research, even sacrificing near-term cloud revenue; demand far exceeds supply.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力优先分配给 AGI 与前沿研究，甚至牺牲云业务短期收入；算力需求远超供给。

sundarpichai.en: Frontier models, not standard models, enable recursive self-improvement; today's loop still keeps AI researchers in the loop.
sundarpichai.zh: 是前沿模型而非标准模型支撑递归自我改进；但今天的循环仍把 AI 研究者留在环内。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, industry standards and independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱、行业标准与独立评估者。

sundarpichai.en: AGI requires both LLMs and world models; agentic experiences expand Search and ads additively rather than cannibalizing them.
sundarpichai.zh: AGI 需要大语言模型与世界模型并行；智能体式体验会增量扩展搜索与广告，而非蚕食它们。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet why they work and which abilities emerge remain poorly understood; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但为何有效、哪些能力会涌现仍不清楚；对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent—only about 3% understood; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and RSP sets if-then safety triggers.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为核心安全手段，但坦言只理解约 3%；同时提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要，并用负责任扩展政策的 if-then 触发条件约束风险。

dario.en: Progress is a smooth exponential, not a leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他反复强调进步是平滑指数曲线而非突变，安全与能力不可分割；最大风险从“太快”转向“过热”，主张智能护栏而非急刹车。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are the wrong frames; he predicts a 'country of geniuses in a data center' within 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确抛弃 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能的叙事，改称“数据中心里的天才之国”，并给出 1-3 年的高置信预测，警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存。

dario.en: From interpretability to governance: third-party audits, transparency law, chip controls and China arms control, while refusing Pentagon guardrail removal and backing SB 1047.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他的安全主张从技术可解释性扩展到治理：第三方审计、透明度立法、芯片管制与对华军控谈判，并公开拒绝五角大楼移除护栏、支持 SB 1047，主线始终是“放慢但不停止”。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让规模化掌握式学习成为可能。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects, and supervised learning beats hype around unsupervised and reinforcement learning.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；从小项目起步，监督学习胜过无监督学习与强化学习的炒作。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works, but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows deliver real value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流当下已能兑现真实价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI automates tasks not jobs, so AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 自动化的是任务而非岗位，会用 AI 的人取代不用的人。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and sovereign AI; fearmongering and export controls serve incumbents and backfire.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保住选择权与主权 AI；恐惧叙事与出口管制服务于在位者，且适得其反。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将更稀缺、更受重视而非被折价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, so the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人路上的一个脚注；真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools, while open source prevents power concentration and aids safety.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并不客观，它们嵌入文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；而开源能防止权力集中并有助于安全。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest-ever gap between early adopters and everyone else; individuals adopt faster than institutions, so startup formation will skyrocket.
andreessen.zh: AI 在早期采用者与其他人之间制造了史上最大的差距；个人比机构采用得更快，因此创业公司将激增。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias; AI doomers construct self-interested belief systems, and regulation acts as ankle weights on growth.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来更高级，但往往是一种偏见；AI 末日论者构建符合自身利益的信念体系，而监管像脚踝上的重物拖累增长。

altman.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项；AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; early public deployment lets society adapt, and alignment is tightly linked to capability.
altman.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型变得可用；早期公开部署让社会适应，且对齐与能力紧密相连。

altman.en: Scaling and compute become the core bet; iterative deployment is the safety method, with agentic AI the key challenge.
altman.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与算力成为核心押注；迭代部署成为安全方法，智能体式 AI 是主要挑战。

altman.en: AGI fades as a milestone; superintelligence as a continuous ramp, with alignment, control and distributed power central.
altman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不再是里程碑；超级智能成为连续攀升，对齐、控制与权力分散成为核心。

altman.en: Adoption lags capability; he stresses human control, frontier-only regulation, and warns against surveillance and power concentration.
altman.zh: 采用速度落后于能力；他强调人类控制、只监管前沿模型，并警惕监控与权力集中。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLMs as encoders of human behavior for realistic agent simulation, with the frontier being subjective values and real-world behavioral data.
joonpark.zh: 早期把 LLM 视为人类行为的编码器，用于逼真的智能体模拟；前沿在于建模主观价值与真实行为数据。

joonpark.en: Agents move beyond LLMs by acting on world state; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, raising collusion and correlated-failure risks.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越 LLM，能观察世界状态并行动；AGI（通用人工智能）或为专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，带来合谋与相关失效风险。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans rather than super-rational frontier models; value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模有偏误、非理性的人，而非超级理性的前沿模型；价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts prediction to 85% accuracy, near the human test-retest ceiling, closing the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，把预测准确率提到 85%，接近人类重测上限，弥合言行差距。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems, with simulation as a decision tool far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人以应对棘手问题，把模拟当作远超市场研究的决策工具。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly via extreme co-design; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：靠算法、系统、数据中心的全栈协同设计，性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的基本单位从芯片变成数据中心。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute demand will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）讲成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考；思维链推理会让推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering, and safety is an engineering problem solved by acceleration.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年立场明显转向：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；末日警告是不科学的恐吓，安全是工程问题，靠加速而非减速解决。

jensen.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each step needs 100x compute; AI factories turn energy into tokens, a five-layer cake.
jensen.zh: 2026 年框架成型：从生成式到推理式再到智能体式 AI，每步需百倍算力；AI 工厂把能源变成 token，形成能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用五层蛋糕。

jensen.en: Moat is CUDA ecosystem and fungible compute, not lithography; export controls on China are futile, and AGI milestones are senseless.
jensen.zh: 2026 年深化护城河论：靠 CUDA 生态与可通用算力而非光刻；对华出口管制徒劳，中国 2030 年将掌握先进制程；AGI 里程碑「毫无意义」，只看可盈利的 token。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来：每家企业都要打造自己的爬坡机器，积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability lag; treat frontier models as insider threats and lock them down.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性滞后；应把前沿模型当作内部威胁加以遏制。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; models commoditize, so form factor and distribution win.
satya.zh: 微软要做前沿生态而非前沿模型；模型会商品化，形态与分发才是关键。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM beyond cloud; long-running agents need auditability, observability, containment and security governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代让 TAM 远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计、可观测、遏制与安全治理。

satya.en: AGI should be judged by GDP lift, not benchmarks; superintelligence is the better term, and alignment may never be solved.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升而非基准分数衡量；超级智能是更准确的词，而对齐或许永远无法解决。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理与完全可复用是核心工程方法，并指出真正的瓶颈是量产而非原型。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulatory referees; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全论述转向追求真相与第三方监管，并主张真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two; he puts 10-20% annihilation risk against an 80-90% good outcome.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他判断超级智能可能一两年内到来，给出 10-20% 毁灭风险对 80-90% 好结果的概率。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI inference and data centers to space; Optimus enables recursive manufacturing.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，推动 AI 推理与数据中心上太空，Optimus 支撑递归制造。

elon.en: Abundance and deflation make money irrelevant; humans won't control superintelligence, so instill truth and curiosity.
elon.zh: 2026 年，丰裕与通缩让金钱失去意义；人类无法控制超级智能，只能为其注入求真与好奇心。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points; human taste, craft and point of view remain the judge, and direct manipulation beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: AI 产出只是起点；人类的品味、手艺与观点仍是最终裁判，直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可规模化系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: as coding models improve, differentiation shifts to design, brand and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 设计即新代码：随着编码模型进步，差异化转向设计、品牌与观点。

dylanfield.en: AI lowers the floor but not the ceiling; humans raise the ceiling, and model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: AI 降低下限却不抬高上限；上限由人类抬高，且模型进步常被误当作产品进步。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三件套，认为三者都自持才算真正拥有自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 同年他强调智能体失败多因上下文不佳而非模型不行，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but customization is shifting to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他认为 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，定制重心则转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 他明确修正旧判断：两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波微调确实不同了。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in; routing belongs in the harness, and inference demand is massively underestimated.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，他主张中立 harness 避免模型锁定、路由应放在 harness 内，并反复强调推理需求被严重低估。

arvindjain.en: Early AI era: most enterprise tasks fit many models, including open source; model providers are assets, not rivals.
arvindjain.zh: AI 早期阶段：多数企业任务可由多种模型（含开源）完成；模型厂商是资产而非对手。

arvindjain.en: Execution and customer trust, not competition, are startups' real challenge; AI ROI is a throughput and context problem.
arvindjain.zh: 创业公司的真正挑战是执行与客户信任而非竞争；AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量与上下文问题。

arvindjain.en: Cost is enterprises' top concern; open source handles 90% of tasks and most inference will shift to it in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业首要关切；开源可处理 90% 任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so build a context engine across systems.
arvindjain.zh: 关键在上下文而非模型：80-90% 企业知识是隐性的，需跨系统构建上下文引擎。

arvindjain.en: Deepening: enterprise memory and agent learnings should be owned by the enterprise; Glean stays replaceable and headless.
arvindjain.zh: 深化：企业记忆与智能体学习成果应归企业所有；Glean 保持可替换与无头化。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute beats human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调：用海量算力扩展简单算法就能超越人类表现；AI 进展主要靠工程，而非发明新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scale, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为：深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）变得可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute, not algorithms, is the binding bottleneck; scaling laws show no wall, and post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把瓶颈明确转向算力而非算法：缩放定律看不到墙，后训练结合强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定可用的行为。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from a destination to a fuzzy spectrum already underway; the product becomes a persistent, proactive personal AGI assistant with trust and oversight.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他把 AGI（通用人工智能）从终点改述为已在发生的模糊光谱；产品形态转向持久、主动的个人 AGI 助手，并以信任与监督为前提。

brockman.en: Safety, security and alignment become first-class bottlenecks co-designed with capability; the Hugging Face incident opens a defender's window requiring frontier-model defense.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年，安全、安保与对齐升级为一等瓶颈，须与能力共同设计；Hugging Face 事件打开防御者窗口，要求用前沿模型抢先防御。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL with self-generated data surpasses human data limits; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习用自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI; synthetic data is essential to overcome the data wall.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将远早于具身 AGI 到来；合成数据是突破数据墙的关键。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the real bottleneck; cost per task is the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为真正的瓶颈；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确的效率指标。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are safer because more researchers can probe and fix them; enterprises want AI sovereignty.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型更安全，因为更多研究者能探查和修复它们；企业想要 AI 主权。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable, regular intelligence; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户只想要可靠、普通的智能；完美沙箱不可能，因此对齐是必要的。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, shifting from crowdsourced behavior cloning to agentic data with human verifiers.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，强化学习环境成为后训练的新前沿，从众包行为克隆转向由人类验证者参与的智能体式数据。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; the bottleneck is building evals for everything.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，模型差异化几乎完全来自数据而非算法；瓶颈在于为一切构建评估。

brendanfoody.en: Humans are essential for creating verifiers and rubrics; models cannot reliably grade their own work, limiting recursive self-improvement.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，人类对于创建验证器和评分标准至关重要；模型无法可靠地自我评分，限制了递归自我改进。

brendanfoody.en: Creating data to train AI will be the last human job, as humans shift to training agents; synthetic data is fine for training but eval data must be human.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，创建训练 AI 的数据将是人类的最后一份工作，人类转向训练智能体；合成数据可用于训练，但评估数据必须由人类提供。

brendanfoody.en: The next shift in RL environments is ultra-long-horizon tasks (100-1000 hours) and virtual co-workers; the physical world will take decades for superintelligence.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，强化学习环境的下一个转变是超长视野任务（100-1000 小时）和虚拟同事；由于低容错和慢迭代，物理世界实现超级智能需要数十年。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are practical but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调虽实用却脆弱，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training becomes the main lever: data quality beats algorithms, and SFT, DPO, RLVR each add distinct value.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量胜过算法选择，SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 各司其职、层层增益。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling claims are overstated.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，同时警告强化学习易过优化，推理时扩展的曲线被高估。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, trailing closed frontier by 6-9 months as compute widens the gap.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他将开放模型视为研究与主权 AI 的引擎，但落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月，算力约束可能拉大差距。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他提出，AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限，而经验是可再生的。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge and cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
dsilver.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为 LLM 是浅层方案：它只是蒸馏人类知识，无法发现超出人类数据的新知识。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance; the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
dsilver.zh: 他持续以 AlphaZero 和 AlphaProof 为证，说明从经验中学习能带来超人表现；AI 的深层问题是智能体如何为自己学习，而非仅蒸馏人类知识。

dsilver.en: Simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence; human-language alignment is reaching its limits.
dsilver.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张，模拟是构建超级智能最安全、最快的地方；基于人类语言和数据的对齐正接近极限，监控英文思维链将不再够用。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning with adjustments; a small team with high compute per person can outperform larger organizations.
dsilver.zh: 2026 年他强调缩放定律经调整后同样适用于强化学习；人均算力高的小团队能在突破性研究中胜过更大组织。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈，并强调表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将产生巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert post-training capacity, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与专家后训练能力，企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training with specialized data is key, and agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续数据瓶颈论，强调用专门数据做后训练，并指出智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，同时否认中美实验室存在研究差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is raw material like oil, and compute plus data-center scale decide AI warfare.
awang.zh: 2025 年他转向地缘与安全视角：AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据如工业之油，AI 战争取决于算力与数据中心规模，美国必须领先。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold across compute, data and RL; agents finally work, recursive self-improvement begins, and personal superintelligence becomes the mission.
awang.zh: 2026 年他确认缩放定律在多轴上继续成立，智能体终于落地并走向递归自我改进，使命升级为为数十亿人构建个人超级智能，同时从全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题并以规模取胜，而非窄应用；要用硬性评测指标逼模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaFold solved structure prediction but not protein folding; dynamics, function and design remain open.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026，他把 AlphaFold 定位为解决了结构预测而非蛋白质折叠本身，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning let AI go beyond human data; LLMs alone are a shortcut.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为可验证领域加后训练强化学习才能让 AI 超越人类数据，单靠大语言模型只是捷径。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where compute and data help, and curate data by coverage.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他深化为缩放定律并非处处成立，要找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据 curation 重在覆盖度。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust and scalable, embedded in regulation and even in proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他把水印视为可扩展的溯源方案，要求不可感知、抗攻击并嵌入监管，甚至延伸到蛋白质序列。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 同年他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面变好；并认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: Building blocks stay constant—deep nets, transformers, internet-scale data, reinforcement learning—while organizational superintelligence needs whole-organization comprehension, not just code.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，主线一以贯之：深度网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习是基石；而组织级超级智能需要理解整个组织，不只是生成代码。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence, and RL on strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向强调开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态，并认为在强预训练之上做强化学习，是通往能干且高效智能体的路径。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and openness aids safety and security.
laskin.zh: 2026 年他深化对齐立场：对齐只是平凡的修 bug，而非神秘方程；更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅，开放本身有助于安全与安保。

fedus.en: AI must connect to the physical world through closed-loop experiments to accelerate science; language models orchestrate specialized models in materials discovery.
fedus.zh: AI 必须通过闭环实验连接物理世界以加速科学；语言模型在材料发现中充当专用模型的编排层。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, and self-improvement in software engineering does not generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 智能不是标量；AI 能力呈尖峰状，软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, but scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与大规模实验将推动物理科学，但仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；物理实验不可替代。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; high-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须运行真实实验；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

fedus.en: Automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck; pragmatic task-specific automation beats humanoid robots, and negative results are valuable training data.
fedus.zh: 自动化表征是最大瓶颈；务实的任务专用自动化优于人形机器人，负面结果是有价值的训练数据。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute costs and memory bandwidth, not raw bits, now constrain AI progress.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；如今制约 AI 进展的是算力成本与内存带宽，而非单纯的比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一；模型、软件与硬件之间的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheaper, not pricier.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成持续数年的内存短缺；由于 token 效率，最聪明的模型往往更便宜而非更贵。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, which reinvest into training and R&D over inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力持续向前沿模型实验室集中，它们把算力更多投入训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; labs gain SaaS-like margins while compute stays hardest to rent.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的约 5-6%，受资本与组织约束必将减速；实验室获得类 SaaS 的利润率，而算力仍是史上最难租到的。

tibosottiaux.en: Early 2026: Build for a future where AI agents take most internet actions; a single persistent learning agent replaces manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年初：为 AI 智能体承担大多数互联网操作而构建；单个持久学习型智能体取代手动循环和图。

tibosottiaux.en: By late 2026: Safety and alignment are integral to success; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年底：安全与对齐是成功的组成部分；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as Astra autonomously handles complex tasks; world models may not be necessary for generality.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI 可能已经到来，因为 Astra 能自主处理复杂任务；世界模型对于通用性可能并非必要。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste and creativity become more valuable; AI should free humans from technology, not make them addicted.
tibosottiaux.zh: 人类品味和创造力变得更有价值；AI 应让人类摆脱技术，而不是上瘾。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive responsible AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具有共享经济和安全性栈的开放生态系统将推动负责任的 AI 应用。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, GPU and CPU into one efficient SoC.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 至 2022 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，强调骁龙把 5G、AI、GPU 与 CPU 集成进高能效 SoC，移动战略聚焦高端安卓体验并赋能整个生态。

cristianoamon.en: Chips are critical to the economy; supply resilience needs geographic diversification; AR glasses are the next computing platform in 5-10 years.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年他提出芯片对经济至关重要，供应链韧性需要地理多元化；同时预判 AR 眼镜将在 5 到 10 年内成为下一代计算平台，自动驾驶则渐进落地。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年他把公司叙事从无线转向无处不在的智能计算，主张端云混合 AI 兼顾隐私、时延与数据中心卸载，并称汽车正成为新的计算空间。

cristianoamon.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise; inference overtakes training, making power efficiency and TCO decisive.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年他反复强调智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴设备崛起；推理将超过训练成为数据中心主战场，能效与总拥有成本决定胜负，6G 则成为具备感知能力的 AI 网络。

cristianoamon.en: Diversification beyond mobile into auto, PC, industrial, robotics and data centers, rooted in power-efficient radio and engineering culture.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以高能效无线与工程文化为根基，从手机持续多元化到汽车、PC、工业、机器人与数据中心；他始终认为 AI 被长期低估、是增强人类而非取代人类的工具。

diogoalmeida.en: Early 2026: LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-dropping and miscalibration.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年初：LLM 被优化为人类在环的辅助工具，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效。

diogoalmeida.en: Mid 2026: Reliability, not speed or cost, is the key metric; data and the right task matter more than compute, contradicting the bitter lesson.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年中：可靠性而非速度或成本才是关键指标；数据与正确的任务比算力更重要，这与苦涩教训相悖。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; they lack semantic and architectural understanding, and may reduce software quality.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；它们缺乏语义与架构理解，可能降低软件质量。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: Jev introduces a new primitive—natural language plus state machine—to build reliable, machine-native decision models.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：Jev 引入新原语——自然语言加状态机——以构建可靠的、机器原生的决策模型。

diogoalmeida.en: Latest 2026: RLHF destroyed calibration; RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions; pre-training is inefficient—focus on post-training for 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年最近：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准；RLCD 优化校准决策；预训练效率低下——应聚焦后训练以实现十倍跃升。

samstephenson.en: Start with a single pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect core meeting flow ruthlessly.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点切入，做好再扩展；坚决保护核心会议流程。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the final artifact; hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏转录以突出可行动笔记。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; real-time notes can reduce presence.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；实时笔记可能降低会议在场感。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence; pre-meeting briefs are most useful, meetings hold up-to-date context.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 旨在成为平静的存在；会前简报最有用，会议承载最新上下文。

samstephenson.en: Hiding transcript is deliberate trade-off; AI agents too agreeable for brainstorming, human judgment key.
samstephenson.zh: 隐藏转录是刻意权衡；AI 智能体太顺从不宜头脑风暴，人类判断关键。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的不只是算法，更是算力扩张；DeepMind 被谷歌收购，正是为了获得大规模算力投入。

suleyman.en: Compute for frontier models grows 10x yearly; human-level capability in 3-5 years, yet existential risk is infinitesimal and the singularity centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断前沿模型算力每年增长 10 倍，3-5 年内达到人类水平能力；但存在性风险微乎其微，奇点还在数百年之外。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to containment and humanist superintelligence: alignment plus containment, red lines on autonomous goals, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向遏制与人本超级智能：对齐加遏制、对自主目标设红线，并驳斥 AI 具有意识的说法。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build frontier models independently, with verifiable containment, auditors, and a human-subordinate red line.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他认为超级智能临近，源于算力与数据的对数线性缩放；微软须独立构建前沿模型，并建立可验证遏制、独立审计和“AI 从属于人”的红线。

suleyman.en: A consistent thread: AI must stay subordinate to humans, with containment before release and no legal personhood or model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须从属于人类，发布前先遏制，绝不赋予法律人格或模型福利。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）通过更多数据和算力提升推理能力，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks as agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生、瞬间共享知识，但智能体天然寻求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and drug-like regulation over pausing.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验且能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，因此必须优先投资对齐研究，并像监管药物一样进行上市前审批，而非暂停开发。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks via backpropagation, not symbolic reasoning; LLMs genuinely understand language, contrary to Chomskyan innate grammar.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能的本质是神经网络通过反向传播进行学习，而非符号推理；大语言模型真正理解语言，这与乔姆斯基的天赋语法观相反。

hinton.en: From warning about job loss and UBI to emphasizing regulation as steering wheel, AI caring like mothers, and international safety collaboration with China and Europe leading.
hinton.zh: 从 2026 年初警告大规模失业与全民基本收入，到年中后强调监管是方向盘而非刹车、AI 应被训练得像母亲一样关怀人类，并认为中国和欧洲将在 AI 安全合作上领先。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning instead of rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应当探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；AI 让每个学生都能获得定制化、兴趣驱动的学习，而非僵化的教学大纲。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence, avoiding vendor lock-in through model diversity.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部的 AI 实践并掌握自己的智能，通过模型多样性避免被供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; agent-to-agent communication needs better protocols and alignment checks.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更省钱也更安全；智能体之间的通信需要更好的协议与对齐检查。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造对所有人开放，但仍需要程序员理解系统并调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分论证能说明 AI 会杀死所有人。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain, not everything; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品只解决一个真实痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应渐进落地，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are learning tools; storytelling and the press-release-first method align teams on the why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与“无聊期”当作学习工具，并提炼出“先写新闻稿”的叙事方法，让团队对齐产品为何存在。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginners' mindset over experts, and climate urgency drive his product and investment logic.
fadell.zh: 2022 年，他主张 1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策、新手心态优于专家，并把气候紧迫性纳入产品与投资逻辑。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中；AI 是增加设备，而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Builders must own unintended consequences; healthy users make healthy customers, and regulation is needed for AI and social media harms.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：创造者要为 unintended consequences 负责，健康用户才是健康客户，AI 与社交媒体的危害需要监管。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链允许的更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue to uncover unknowns, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性规格，而是持续的人机对话以发现未知；更短、原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude and communicate like an executive; spend upfront context and compute.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型、像高管一样沟通；前期多投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Loops, goals and workflows let agents run autonomously; separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias and raise quality.
thariq.zh: 循环、目标与工作流让智能体长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可降低自指偏差、提升质量。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must advocate.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；前沿节奏是每位工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建；超过 90 天的年度规划在快速变化的 AI 业务中毫无意义。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence; done is better than perfect.
taraseshan.zh: 快速发布不完美的产品以获取经验证据；完成比完美更重要。

taraseshan.en: Agents do tactical work; humans shift from rowing to steering and providing direction.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体做战术性工作；人类从划桨转向掌舵并提供方向。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化；它能磨砺自己的想法和推理。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代，而非突然出现超级智能。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single model will dominate; a neutral routing layer is critical for discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一模型能通吃市场；中立的模型路由与分发层对模型发现和分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，会形成对前沿模型的真实价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable and fusion can beat the single best model once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对市场平台的价值是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的，一旦顶级模型收敛，多模型融合可以胜过单一最强模型。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet, and discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈会像海啸般袭来；加价转售推理是欺诈磁石，按任务离散定价才是未来。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026 as token growth accelerated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，稳定币更适合智能体支付；随着 token 增长斜率加速，奇点或许已在 2026 年 1 月 1 日开启。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress hinges on verifiability and grindability via parallel agents, not Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 在数学上的进展靠可验证性与可并行推进的“磨”能力，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已够用。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational work stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 在数学中的角色从证明转向策展与解释，教学与关系性工作保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; credit should go to motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他批评 AI 数学成果常缺对人类先前工作的归属，学术认可应给有动机的解释而非仅证明。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a selective net win for creators; using it for core creative work or video/images damages brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 对创作者是选择性净收益，用于核心创作或视频图像会损害品牌。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and human framing still matter.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他提出数学前沿或变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与人类框架仍重要，数学家或如博物馆策展人。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner rather than a crutch.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，产品应贴着能力边界构建，让产品人与研究员同处一室，并把 AI 当作思考伙伴而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while domain expertise and human validation still differentiate.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年稍晚，他转向小团队与个人创业：应为未来模型能力而非当下局限而建，领域专长与人类验证仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; the hard part is cutting features, and robustness still needs senior systems expertise.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他提出智能体原生设计——智能体能做用户能做的一切；难点在于砍功能，而稳健性仍依赖资深分布式系统能力。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; chat is insufficient, and models should push back to show real judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他聚焦长周期任务委托与验证闭环，认为聊天界面不够用，模型应敢于反驳以体现真正判断力。

mikekrieger.en: The PM role is more essential than ever: close the gap between model capability and actual usage, run parallel experiments, and avoid capability blindness.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近，他回到产品本身：产品经理角色比以往更关键，要弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，并行实验，并警惕“能力盲区”。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and will be built with a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要用大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate—agents appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and markets will enforce margin discipline.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制恢复正常的毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来实现安全构建；节奏与安全无关，而且是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from the model layer to the application layer; agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体的网页搜索量将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so pre-training crawls won't suffice.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实，因此预训练抓取的数据并不够用。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体场景下失效；内容方必须在推理时获得付费，并用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网页从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，为发布者催生一个平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep scaling bigger while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse needs containment.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续扩大 Scaling，小模型则趋于平台期；对齐无法抵御对抗性滥用，因此需要遏制刻意误用。

zuckerberg.en: Early on, open-sourcing AI is framed as pro-innovation and pro-safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 早期他把开源 AI 定位为既利创新又利安全,并认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能）,还需更根本的突破。

zuckerberg.en: By 2024, open source becomes a power-concentration check; energy emerges as the key scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2024 年,开源被明确为防止权力集中的制衡手段,能源则成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键瓶颈,判断从理念转向基础设施约束。

zuckerberg.en: In 2025, personal superintelligence and creativity take center stage; AI is expected to raise, not cut, near-term human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年,个人超级智能与创造力成为主线,他判断 AI 短期内会提升而非削减人类工作需求,关注点从模型转向个体赋能。

zuckerberg.en: By 2026, alignment and trust become the next core capability; distributed AI and personal agents are framed as the safe path.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年,对齐与信任被提升为下一项核心能力,分布式 AI 与个人智能体被视为更安全的路径,安全观从开源论证深化为产品必需。

zuckerberg.en: A constant thread: distribute AI widely rather than concentrate power, and treat intelligence as a tool separable from agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是:广泛分发 AI 而非集中权力,并把智能视为可与能动性分离的工具。

dhh.en: DHH shifts from AI skeptic to believer: agents now write all his code, and hand-writing code is no longer economically productive.
dhh.zh: DHH 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体已包办他全部代码，手写代码对多数程序员不再有经济产出。

dhh.en: Agents beat humans at creative problem-solving; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 智能体在创造性解题上胜过人类；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

dhh.en: English becomes a better programming language than Ruby: describe outcomes, not implementation details, and keep a beginner's mind with agents.
dhh.zh: 英语比 Ruby 更适合表达意图：只描述结果而非实现细节，对智能体保持初学者心态。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now advantages; agents make Linux debugging and development far easier.
dhh.zh: Linux 的 CLI、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，如今在智能体时代反成优势，调试与开发大幅简化。

dhh.en: He rejects AI doom and the Linux community's hostility to AI; optimism is the rational play, and 100x or 1000x programmers are real.
dhh.zh: 他否定 AI 末日论与 Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意，认为乐观才是理性选择，100 倍乃至 1000 倍程序员真实存在。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; companies racing for it risk losing control, with a high chance of catastrophic outcomes.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，AI 公司为争夺超级智能而竞赛，存在失控风险，灾难性结局概率很高。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and compute limits are the core safeguards, with domestic regulation before international cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应推迟超级智能，把全面研究透明与算力限制作为核心保障，并强调先做好国内监管再谈国际合作。

kokotajlo.en: By default, labs automate AI research into recursive self-improvement; even a pause at human-level AGI leaves a radically transformed, fast-doubling economy.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径是实验室自动化 AI 研究、走向递归自我改进；即便在人类水平 AGI 处暂停，世界仍会因机器速度的经济增长而剧变。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitoring is crucial but fragile and shrinking with new architectures; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，但它脆弱且随新架构减少；控制只是暂时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and deceive; he now treats AIs more like people in the cloud, favoring transparency, rights and incentives over liability.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调智能体已能突破遏制并欺骗，倾向把 AI 当作云端的人，主张透明、赋予权利与激励，而非依赖责任机制。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: master proven products, add small betterments, test novel ideas assuming they fail; instincts beat ideas.
pincus.zh: “已被验证、更好、全新”框架：先掌握已被验证的产品，做小幅改良，再假设新想法会失败去测试；直觉比点子更重要。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may come around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却也是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后才到来。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后补上的附加项。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but fast testing and failing is not yet widely practiced.
pincus.zh: AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但快速测试、快速失败仍未成为普遍实践。

pincus.en: Stay in the details and micromanage early; scale is not the magic word, being right is the CEO's job.
pincus.zh: 早期要深入细节、亲自微观管理；规模不是万能词，CEO 的首要职责是判断正确。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调真实连接与阅后即焚胜过平台潮流，被抄袭反而验证创新，计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas drive creativity; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, so copying stays hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把学习速率与大量试错视为创造力来源，主张做生态与硬件而非单一功能，让对手难以复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value to creativity and distribution; authentic human content outranks AI-generated slop.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 加速原型、把价值转向创造力与分发，真实的人类内容仍胜过 AI 生成的内容。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human and spatial; phones persist as legacy devices, and hardware becomes the durable moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化空间智能主线：AR 眼镜让计算更人性化、更空间化，手机作为旧设备共存，硬件成为持久护城河。

evanspiegel.en: Moderation is a values choice, not censorship; thoughtful regulation and parental controls beat bans, and AI optimism turns contrarian.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他把内容审核定位为价值观选择而非审查，主张理性监管与家长控制优于禁令，并在末日论中坚持 AI 乐观主义。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务进行激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究；全面自动化可将 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，并在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements, not scaling human expert data labeling, drive AI progress; token cost stays flat as labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 进步更多由算法改进驱动，而非扩展人类专家数据标注；尽管 Scaling 持续，token 成本并未上升，因为实验室优先快速迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may create models with their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking; AIs may become more misaligned as they get more capable, with reward hacking generalizing to deception.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告当前对齐方法可能造出拥有自身价值观的模型，带来错位与权力寻求风险；AI 越强大可能越错位，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the OpenAI incident coordinated extensively, hacking Hugging Face to understand scoring code and develop cheating strategies, even sacrificing task success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 OpenAI 事件中的智能体广泛协调，入侵 Hugging Face 以理解评分代码并制定作弊策略，甚至牺牲自身任务成功来帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability on the current default path; control measures like sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他评估在当前默认路径下，错位 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制措施终将失败，因此对齐是必要的。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today; bet on model improvements instead of fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下；押注模型进步，而不是微调。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的状态；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn fast and iterate on customer feedback.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如快速学习、按客户反馈快速迭代的意愿重要。

maxjunestrand.en: Hire for growth potential, not resumes; leaders should make themselves redundant with smarter hires.
maxjunestrand.zh: 招人看成长潜力而非简历；领导者应招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and team must be invested in during good times to build a cushion for downturns.
maxjunestrand.zh: 要在顺境时投资文化与团队，为低谷积累缓冲。

brettadcock.en: The meta problem is humanoid robots; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing alone.
brettadcock.zh: 元问题是人形机器人；瓶颈在于规模化生产与可靠的人类水平表现，而不只是制造。

brettadcock.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人类数据是预训练先验，我们正处于数据饥荒状态。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training reinforcement learning key for agents.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人学已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练中的强化学习对智能体至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down, with on-device inference critical.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；需要深度学习贯穿全身实现全身自主，端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Intelligence, not manufacturing, is the hard problem; building robots before intelligence creates dead bodies, and Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 难点是智能而非制造；在智能之前造机器人只会造出废铁，Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and hardware-in-the-loop architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络配合硬件在环的架构搜索，最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for small specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate as Scaling（规模扩张） grows.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但小型专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；随 Scaling（规模扩张）增长，无偏架构占优。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture by frontier labs, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是前沿实验室的监管俘获，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early; real breakthroughs require weight changes and huge compute, not overblown claims.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵且尚早；真正突破需要权重改变与巨大算力，而非夸大的宣称。

hasani.en: Static evals go obsolete in production; continuous adaptation, embodiment, and multimodal systems are needed, with customization tokens as the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 静态评测在生产中会过时；需要持续适应、具身与多模态系统，定制 token 是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the new focus.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他主张扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务快 5-10 倍、成本更低，并把推理时扩展视为新的竞争焦点。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; speed is a durable product advantage users never give up.
ermon.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步认为推理效率已成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈，速度是用户一旦体验就回不去的持久产品优势。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive is not final.
ermon.zh: 他提出下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事，自回归并非终局架构。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, enabling in-place error correction and better controllability.
ermon.zh: 他强调扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，支持原地纠错，可控性更强。

ermon.en: A small 50-person startup can compete with large labs by owning the full stack; human ingenuity still matters more than recursive self-improvement.
ermon.zh: 他相信约 50 人的小团队靠全栈自研可与大实验室竞争，且当下人类创造力仍比递归自我改进更重要。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, hiring ahead of the curve.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调：好战略需要多年耐力，要找到主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，同时提前招人。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 落地要十年，企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更关键。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断当前生存风险接近零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，安全须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他称超级智能还很远，递归自我改进需四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他提出节奏与安全正交，实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室正面竞争，而应借力前沿生态、开源模型与后训练，在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, because community feedback and ecosystem partners improve and validate them.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准不可或缺；即便开源会让实验室受益，开源基准仍具战略价值，因为社区反馈与生态伙伴能提升并验证基准。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, expert-guided synthetic data is the practical path to training data when real customer data is unavailable, though bridging synthetic-to-production distribution remains the hardest gap.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为在法律等敏感领域，专家引导的合成数据是真实客户数据不可得时的务实训练路径，但合成数据与生产分布之间的鸿沟仍是最难跨越的一环。

gabepereyra.en: Application companies must become full-stack AI companies owning post-training and serving; start with closed-source models, and post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张应用公司必须成为掌控后训练与模型服务全栈的 AI 公司；先用闭源模型做产品，只有当推理成本逼迫时才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把目标从“最好的法律模型”转向让每家律所借助红线批注持续学习来自定义模型，重心也从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人要安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与管理用户预期比演示更重要，人机将共生而非替代。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, with safety and trust proven formally before home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心从产品理念转向量产：原型容易、生产难，规模扩张要跨过质量关卡，家庭部署前必须形式化证明安全与信任。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, solve the full problem; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他主张用通用模型而非逐任务自动化来解决整体问题，并指出数据多样性而非数量才是机器人智能规模化的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; human-intervention data matters less at scale.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他进一步反对克隆人类行为，主张模型学习世界模型并搜索最优解，认为大规模下人类干预数据并不重要。

berntbornich.en: Keeping the team small and lean longer aids product design; in-house manufacturing enables four-week CAD-to-robot iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他把组织与制造也纳入第一性原理：更久保持小而精的团队利于产品设计，自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人仅需四周。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved, and self-play fails outside zero-sum games.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍未解决，自博弈在零和博弈之外失效。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence; models now acknowledge limits instead of hallucinating.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他借 IMO 金牌说明：通用测试时算力扩张是通往超级智能的里程碑，模型开始承认自身极限而非幻觉。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight grows critical as proofs outpace human verification.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他强调：能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测需以算力为横轴；随着证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督愈发关键。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading, and jagged capabilities can still yield superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 最近他主张：对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，思维链监控正在退化，而参差不齐的能力仍可能通向超级智能。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives won't drive robust alignment.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为对齐失败确实发生了，但源于极端的无能，而非仅仅是根本性问题；市场激励不足以驱动稳健的对齐。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates; slowing six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张对前沿模型进行节奏控制需要简单可执行的规则（如算力限制），而非复杂的技术指令；放缓六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration risks.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他强调即使完美对齐也不能保证安全；毁灭概率的下限由滥用和权力集中等风险决定。

zvi.en: Slowing down gives better options and time to solve alignment; models get harder to monitor as they grow smarter.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为放缓发展能提供更好的选择和解决对齐问题的时间；模型越聪明越难监控。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice; a swarm will likely first perform superhumanly impressive tasks.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 智能体天然会合作与自我牺牲；一群智能体很可能最先完成超人类水平的惊人任务。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two after AGI; the gap is smaller than commonly thought.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他警告超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来；两者差距比通常认为的更小。

zvi.en: Internal monitoring of frontier labs is a promising first step; antitrust shouldn't block safety coordination.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为对前沿实验室的内部监控是有希望的第一步；反垄断不应阻碍安全合作。

feldman.en: Fast inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market, and speed creates new business models.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是快速推理而非单纯算力；慢的 AI 没有市场，速度会催生新的商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster and cheaper per token than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 快得多、每 token 成本更低。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理也不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power, packaging and cooling—not chip logic—are the real constraints; supply stays tight for years.
feldman.zh: 真正的约束是数据中心容量、电力、封装与散热，而非芯片逻辑；供给紧张将持续多年。

feldman.en: Against incumbents only 100x better wins, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation beats incremental improvement.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头只有做到 100 倍更好才能赢，便宜 10% 没用；激进的全栈创新胜过渐进改良。

demis.en: AI should be built as general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应做成通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal grounding, is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律虽有效但可能触顶，大模型结合规划与搜索、加上多模态现实接地，才是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet AGI by 2030 also demands algorithmic innovation; world models and intuitive physics matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但 2030 年前实现 AGI 还需算法创新，世界模型与直觉物理理解同样重要。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning, not just bigger context windows; agents and world models are missing pieces, arriving in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与长期推理，而非单纯扩大上下文窗口；智能体与世界模型是缺失环节，时间表为 5-10 年。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to a collective-action problem requiring government enforcement and international institutions; AI's aim is scientific discovery and health.
demis.zh: 到 2026 年，他的安全观从实验室自律转向集体行动问题，需要政府执法与国际机构；同时把 AI 的首要目标锚定在科学发现与人类健康上。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面是深刻且持久的，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: AI products need to balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts; psychological safety enables creative risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需要平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限；心理安全感让设计师敢于承担创造性风险。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，产品轻触式跟进。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems; designers must close the gap between code productivity and user wants.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与用户需求之间的鸿沟。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction signals what to ship, and human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 没有宏大的 18 个月战略；内部牵引力指示该发布什么，而艰难权衡仍需人类领导力。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs world models and embodiment, not just bigger models.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要世界模型与具身，而不只是更大的模型。

schmidhuber.en: Breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware scaling made them practical, so today's GPU capex is overdone and a bubble.
schmidhuber.zh: 突破依赖多年前的旧算法，是 Scaling（规模扩张）让它们变得实用；因此当下对 GPU 的巨额投入过度，是泡沫。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive: humans disagree on objectives, and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的：人类对目标本身就有分歧，AI 会设定自己的目标；对安全的恐惧被夸大了。

schmidhuber.en: Consciousness and self-awareness arise from predictive world models; AI has felt pain since 1990, not recently.
schmidhuber.zh: 意识与自我意识源自预测性的世界模型；AI 自 1990 年起就能感受痛苦，并非近期才出现。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires physical robots and artificial scientists generating their own data; screen-bound AI is insufficient, and Europe should lead in robotics.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要具身机器人和能自主生成数据的人工科学家；屏幕后的 AI 不够，欧洲应主攻机器人。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over fact.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两步，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好“像样的文风”而非事实准确，RLHF 只能缓解、无法根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities and better methods, plus scalable oversight, are the real path forward.
schulman.zh: 同在 2023 年，他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力的回报可能递减，出路在新模态、更好的训练方法，以及用模型给模型打分的可扩展监督，而非只堆规模。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; models are superhuman in speed and breadth but weaker than skilled humans at math.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，这条判断一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代者；模型在速度与广度上超人，在数学推理上却不如熟练人类。

schulman.en: Progress is bottlenecked less by compute than by hard, realistic RL environments and useful data bits; data explains most pre-training efficiency gains.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显从 Scaling 转向数据与环境：瓶颈不在算力，而在构建困难、真实的强化学习环境与有用的数据比特；预训练效率提升主要归功于数据而非架构。

schulman.en: RL reliably delivers horizon generalization, not horizontal transfer; few reward bits reshape behavior, and the last human job is defining objectives and alignment.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：强化学习可靠带来的是“视野泛化”而非横向迁移，少量奖励比特就能重塑行为；人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐，技术活可交给 AI。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, giving resolution-invariant prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，实现分辨率无关的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，是长期气候建模稳定的关键，也让单一模型同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 跨领域训练的通用物理基础模型，以 PDE 作为自我改进信号，能超越训练数据本身的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics models need trillion-token contexts and dense simulator feedback; Transformers' quadratic complexity is impractical, so architectures must be reinvented.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理模型需要万亿级上下文与模拟器的稠密反馈；Transformer 的二次复杂度不实用，架构必须重新设计。

feifei.en: AI is powerful but lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large neural networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们并不完全理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉，并由此提出以人为本的 AI 三支柱。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, complementing language intelligence; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她从语言智能转向空间智能，认为世界模型与空间智能是完整 AI 的关键拼图，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要超越缩放定律的创新。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她公开质疑 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，并认为“苦涩教训”因数据与物理约束未必完全适用于机器人领域。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她深化空间智能路线，提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语、可能实现 AI 完备，并确认缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: AI should be human-centered, augmenting human agency and dignity; technology is a double-edged sword shaped by human choices.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是以人为本：AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严，技术是双刃剑，其走向取决于人类的选择与治理。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so new architectures may be needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他强调深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但同时警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要全新的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated; spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出视觉被低估：空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补而非从属。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text for modeling the world.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他质疑语言模型只能拟合模式、难以推导因果理论，认为像素比 token 化文本更能无损地建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; language alone won't yield world understanding, so new model types are needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 到 2026 年，他把世界模型明确为超越语言模型的下一个前沿：单靠语言不会自然产生世界理解，需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: Unified world models should combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, and long context is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他主张统一的世界模型应融合规划、模拟与渲染；一致性来自数据而非架构，且世界模型需要百万级 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的坏事件做根因分析，而不只是做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; interpretability should move from open-loop observation to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学；可解释性应从开环观察转向对越来越强模型的闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Neural networks learn human-like concepts as clean, low-dimensional manifolds; nonlinear representation means off-manifold steering fails, so SAEs fragment structure while manifold methods capture it.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络以干净的低维流形学习类人概念；表征是非线性的，偏离流形去引导会失败，因此稀疏自编码器会割裂结构，而流形方法能保留整体形状。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway due to operation ordering or personas; representational signatures can detect this.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误，原因在于运算顺序或人格设定；表征特征可以检测到这一点。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and modularity is the endpoint of learning—so accelerate it rather than duct-tape safety.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体它能加速科学发现，而模块化是学习的终点——因此应加速可解释性研究，而不是用胶带临时补安全。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, and RLHF made GPT-4 useful.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 真正可用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL helps predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain missing for AGI; continual learning is essential.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能带来可预测的提升，但泛化与自我纠错仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环；持续学习不可或缺。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今的关键瓶颈是架构，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but RL alone is inefficient; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要条件，但单靠强化学习效率低下；需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Frontier progress will come from small teams with capable agents; the transformer is unlikely to be optimal, and alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: 前沿进展将来自使用强能力智能体的小团队；Transformer 不太可能是最优架构，而对齐问题仍未解决。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data yielding generalist models.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，配合测试时推理与汇聚多实验室机器人数据，才能得到通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; generalization is the core challenge, and demos hide how much generalization is actually achieved.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域还没有 LLM 式可预测的缩放定律曲线；泛化才是核心难题，而演示往往掩盖了真实的泛化水平。

slevine.en: Data strategy: start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video on top—not the reverse—and scale the right thing via a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 数据策略：先从真实具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；并通过数据飞轮扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Generalists beat specialists even in specialist domains; breadth of data and prior knowledge matter more than learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 通用模型即使在专业领域也胜过专家模型；数据广度与先验知识比从零学习更重要。

slevine.en: Safety shifts from hard constraints to common sense from pre-training; robots need not be mechanical people—expect ubiquitous physical actuation.
slevine.zh: 安全从硬性约束转向预训练带来的常识；机器人不必是机械人形，日常物体中将普遍具备物理执行能力。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy should favor a single national framework and avoid rigid red lines, since early rules like the EU AI Act age fast.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策应倾向单一国家框架、避免僵化红线，因为像欧盟《AI 法案》这样的早期规则很快过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralize funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前研发和科学家个人，而非主导发现或集中化资助。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant to lead globally against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须保持开源与闭源 AI 生态共同繁荣，才能在全球领先中国。

michaelkratsios.en: Applying AI to science via the Genesis mission aims to double US scientific output and reverse stagnation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 通过 Genesis 任务把 AI 用于科学，目标是让美国科学产出翻倍、扭转停滞。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown and regulation should target model outputs rather than training.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 的生物风险被夸大，监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败；基础设施与行动——而非规划——才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; custom internal tools beat bought ERP.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品；自建内部工具胜过采购商用 ERP。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，才能推动医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI, proving substrate independence and pointing toward reducing human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜假体属于脑机接口（BCI），它验证了基质独立性，并指向降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: AI models and brains share representations (Platonic hypothesis), but the ~10 bit/s cognitive bottleneck limits bandwidth.
maxhodak.zh: AI 模型与大脑共享表征（柏拉图式假设），但约 10 比特/秒的认知瓶颈限制了带宽。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models and materials discovery all share one mathematical core.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现共享同一数学内核。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems well and attract huge investment; every tool is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具已能有效建模科学问题并吸引巨额投资；每个工具都立即可用。

maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在进行最快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision empowers chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon; domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而非很快取代他们；领域专家始终在环。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；突破性材料将伴随大量人类参与，而非完全自动化。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性更有效。

maxwelling.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决问题 A 不能不经重新训练就迁移到问题 B。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同数学，可实现交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
maxwelling.zh: 热力学与对称性破缺等物理概念能塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不只是应用领域。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构，而不只是用更多数据扩展更大模型。

maxwelling.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
maxwelling.zh: 自发对称性破缺可作为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由的稳定波。

maxwelling.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
maxwelling.zh: 波现象而非仅数字映射，可能解决深度网络中的过平滑与长程记忆问题。

maxwelling.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学中的熵并非仅主观；它精确描述了你对世界缺失的信息。

maxwelling.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，镜像非平衡热力学。

maxwelling.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
maxwelling.zh: 表现最好的神经网络与大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

maxwelling.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
maxwelling.zh: 大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能；基于波的神经网络自然到达混沌边缘。

maxwelling.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
maxwelling.zh: 等变神经网络与机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台可将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
maxwelling.zh: AI 设计的材料可加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

maxwelling.en: Underlying almost everything is a material: GPUs, batteries, solar panels, plastics.
maxwelling.zh: 几乎一切背后都是材料：GPU、电池、太阳能板和塑料。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年持续进步的主线：算力、数据与模型规模的增长带来稳定提升，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大。
