jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Transformer 取代 LSTM 的关键在于并行化与注意力机制，并强调自监督的下一个词预测让文本数据近乎无限。

jeffdean.en: RL from human or machine feedback steers behavior; models now excel on verifiable rewards like math and coding.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈视为引导模型行为的手段，并指出模型在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上已大幅进步。

jeffdean.en: Agents will run for days on decomposed tasks; context engineering and low-latency inference become the bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他的关注点从单次对话转向智能体式系统：智能体能连续数天执行分解任务，上下文工程与低延迟推理成为关键瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the real bottleneck; specialized low-precision hardware and less data movement are key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他明确转向推理侧：推理而非训练才是真正瓶颈，专用低精度芯片与减少数据搬运是扩展智能体系统的核心。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身紧密协作，把 token 和对话当作设计材料，而非像素。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers should prototype with live models and design primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师应用实时模型做原型，并设计人和模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人而非消失，设计与产品、工程的边界正在模糊。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, yet humans stay essential for user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, adaptability and building in public win.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—mock—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度、适应性和公开构建才是关键。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就提出：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: Intelligence is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，反对把 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把基于目标、从经验中学习的强化学习确立为核心范式，认为下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出 AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的简单通用架构，靠奖励假设从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training are dead ends, and LLMs are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他深化主线：持续从真实经验学习才是关键，合成数据与后训练是死路，大语言模型只是智能的一小部分。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——把原子当作比特——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: The entrepreneur matters more than the idea; stealth mode trades external validation for internal correctness and cultural focus.
traviskalanick.zh: 创业者比点子更重要；隐身模式用外部认可换取内部正确性与文化专注。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; efficiency edges create network effects that win market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业规模上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; resilience and taking pain define excellence.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手是对变革的抵抗，而非竞争者；韧性与承受痛苦定义了卓越。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in VC history; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大的浪潮，强调创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小而高度自主的团队借助智能体即可实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型的重要性：制衡前沿模型实验室，避免单一实体掌控超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; individuals can build and control their own agents, echoing the personal computer revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 正在让软件创造民主化，个人可以构建并掌控自己的智能体，这类似个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: AGI won't arrive as one event but diffuse as personal agents; owning your context library and skill files becomes your moat.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的判断深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）不会以单一事件降临，而是以个人智能体形式扩散；拥有自己的上下文库与技能文件才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents are a workforce, not autocomplete; yet society will change slower than expected, over about 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 最近他进一步主张 Markdown 即代码、智能体是劳动力而非自动补全，但同时认为社会变化会比预期慢，约需 20 年。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比直接在全量数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and synthetic data is closer to RL than to simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，并认为机器人合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他转向落地可靠性：物理 AI 容错远低于已部署的机器学习，长期自主依赖可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and embodied data stays irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，应先通用再微调，且具身数据不可替代、开源难以像大语言模型那样普及。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 prior nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness; keep the edges.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口；应保留那些边缘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace the personal computer metaphor with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is the visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and engineering discipline, while AI becomes its primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和工程纪律重建信任，同时 AI 成为其首要增长引擎。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus, with supply—not demand—as the core problem.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 Intel 的转型归结为文化变革、问责与客户导向，并反共识地指出核心问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration creates more value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他聚焦先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料等真正瓶颈，并坚持垂直整合创造更大价值。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 模型统治世界,认为专业化智能将主导;每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型,这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Token costs dropping 10x drives 100x usage; open models give enterprises the customization and control they need.
linqiao.zh: 他指出 Token 成本三年内降 10 倍将带来 100 倍用量增长;开放模型为企业提供所需的定制与控制,是采用的关键。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他深化到后训练:把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型,才是超越产品市场契合的真正护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL progression mirrors human learning from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 他把从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶类比人类学习,从事实到品味再到专长,体现对训练路径的持续思考。

linqiao.en: Post-training cuts costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably; reward engineering lowers the barrier like software engineering.
linqiao.zh: 他主张后训练可降本 5-10 倍,让初创公司盈利扩张;奖励工程类似软件工程,降低了后训练门槛,呼应其反对盲目 Scaling 的主线。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view of the codebase; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体眼中的代码库，用简短迭代的提示而非冗长编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority: sandbox agents, and prompt injection remains an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是首要问题：必须给智能体沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型，但财务上可能难以为继。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building lead to the best ideas; personal brand outlasts any product, and distribution beats tech.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动最好的想法；个人品牌比任何产品更持久，最难的是获得关注而非技术。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and open models can stay near the frontier.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源与安全正交，对齐才是关键层，开源模型能贴近前沿并推动企业采用。

thomaswolf.en: The shift to reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking; a deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警示：无人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客，理想是审慎放缓，但需开放科学以避免监管俘获。

thomaswolf.en: Openness is a consistent thread: from building open robotics communities to arguing open models win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开放：从构建开源机器人社区，到主张开源模型因成本与控制长期胜出。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you can judge them.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：网页本身很混乱，一个想法必须先被做出来、每天使用，才能判断它是否成立。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计团队不必始终作为一个整体行动，保留个人印记和多元声音反而能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Inject feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers; balance intuition with data, guided by vision.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张给浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，在直觉与数据之间取得平衡，并以强烈愿景引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; rich context and prescriptive prompts matter more than mockup labor.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他讲 Claude Design 起初只是一个人的副业项目；提供丰富上下文和明确指令，比亲手做 mockup 更重要。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so volume and human thinking win.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为工程变容易后，设计与想法才是差异化所在；模型仍缺乏品味，因此要靠大量选项和人的思考来补足。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload; its research-to-production timeline is hours, demanding broad expertise and human accountability.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最粘性的工作负载；其从研究到生产的周期仅数小时，需要广泛的专业知识和人类问责。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization can be calibrated for cost and speed.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化分为无损（KV 缓存、推测解码）和有损（量化）；量化可以针对成本和速度进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving toward disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management becoming central; inference engineering merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向分离式预填充和解码，KV 缓存管理成为核心；推理工程与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin are more specialized, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 像 Rubin 这样的未来 GPU 更加专用化，将推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems remain generic relative to models; workload-specific specialization could be 10x more complex and is crucial for agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理系统相对于模型仍然通用；针对工作负载的专门化可能复杂 10 倍，并且对于智能体应用至关重要。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome data walls.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需平衡有用性与无害性；合成数据与强化学习后训练能突破数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; benchmarks saturate faster than new ones are created, so evals must evolve continuously.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续强调评估是瓶颈，基准饱和速度快于新基准创建，因此评估必须持续演进。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练具有主观性，涉及人类判断；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions limits diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，需要持续演进基准；服务数十亿人的单一模型会限制多样性。

karina.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and stay relevant, not rely on a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识并保持相关性，而非依赖单一的共识声音。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will become the new app, with startups winning long-tail business domains; frontier model development is left to hyperscalers due to massive capex.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 智能体将成为新的应用形态，创业公司的机会在特定业务领域的长尾场景；而前沿模型开发因需要巨额资本开支，只适合超大规模厂商。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing beats usage-based pricing because tokens are not a good measure of value; inference costs will drop dramatically.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他主张按结果定价优于按用量定价，因为 token 并非衡量价值的好指标；同时 AI 推理成本将大幅下降，催生新的用例与商业模式。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; fixing bad code requires root-cause analysis, so productivity gains are real but uneven.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调编码智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人；修复错误代码需要根因分析，因此生产力提升真实但并不均衡。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：负责任的迭代部署才是通往安全的路径，要在 GPT-8 之前先把 GPT-7 做安全，而不是在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise—tutors, medical advice—and will create more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him but elevate the role.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调 AI 让专业知识民主化——个性化导师、医疗建议人人可得——并会创造多于取代的就业；智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升了而非消除了人的角色。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; agents need human oversight to be profitable.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会推动就业回流与“分配经济”：CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标，而智能体需要人类监督才能持续创造经济价值。

danshipper.en: AGI defined by economically running agents indefinitely; everyone gets an agent, but humans still frame and oversee the work.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI 重新定义为“能无限期经济地运行智能体”，并预测人人都有智能体；但基准高估自主性，真实任务仍需人类设定框架与监督。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work win, with one company-wide super agent over personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他立场转向：命令行已过时，Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形工作界面才是未来；公司应有一个全公司级超级智能体，而非每人一个个人智能体。

danshipper.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users, and users bring their own AI rather than vendors embedding it.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他反驳“SaaS 将死”：智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，用户会自带 AI 接入，而非由 SaaS 厂商内建 AI。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; even superintelligence stays tool-like, needing human direction.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，主线深化为：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大的是人自身的品味与手艺；即便达到超级智能，它仍是工具，需要人类引导与反馈。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 自建工具、自己写 0% 的代码,从参考出发迭代,而不是从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you need a giant prompt with context and a design system to use superintelligent models well.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明;要用好超级智能模型,你得给出带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾;真正的优势来自把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会,让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Launch at 80% complete and iterate on real feedback; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 做到 80% 就发布,再依据真实反馈迭代;完美主义是恐惧的伪装。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap, and diversification protects ignorance.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的某个痛点且昂贵的问题;风险投资是陷阱,分散只是对无知的保护。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对大多数 Google 产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融领域将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非自噬；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此应让其保持掌控。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace creates opportunity, and deep understanding of code still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化节奏带来机会，而对代码的深层理解依然关键。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software will increase, not decrease.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件需求将增加而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus should be on teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and designing human-agent collaboration interfaces.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已足够，重点应放在教模型真实工程细节和设计人机协作界面上。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他强调编程智能体被大规模采用（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; independence allows model neutrality and long-term enterprise partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；独立性允许模型中立和长期企业合作。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建产品是核心原则，并高度看重通才工程师。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the software engineer title will fade into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他认为编程已基本解决，自己的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，软件工程师头衔将淡出，被‘构建者’取代。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment core to product development.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他强调通过尽早发布来研究安全，Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐是产品开发的核心。

boris.en: Agents evolve into loops and proactive autonomous workflows; the next bottlenecks are code review, security, and idea generation.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体演化为循环与主动自主工作流，下一个瓶颈是代码审查、安全和想法生成。

boris.en: With frontier models, delete most system prompts and code; less instruction and empirical iteration beat upfront design.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他主张面对前沿模型应删除大部分系统提示和代码，少指令、经验迭代胜过前期设计。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a leap in intelligence, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 标志着智能跃升，能支撑更长时间、开放式的智能体任务；脚手架从训练辅助轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 对齐被重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型更有用，而不只是更安全。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; PMs write evals like test-driven development, managers stay hands-on.
diannepenn.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应力与第一性原理思维；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者保持亲自动手。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence cheaply, and maximizing token spend captures future alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以低成本提供 Opus 级智能，最大化 token 支出是在捕捉未来的 alpha。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，使科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make biology an engineering discipline enabling cell programming.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 将使生物学成为可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and GPT-5.5 Pro has crossed the threshold of biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling；GPT-5.5 Pro 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives, aging reverses, and cancer becomes 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达长寿逃逸速度，衰老可逆转，癌症将通过 AI 设计的个性化疗法实现 100% 治愈。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; trusting superintelligence for medical decisions is ethical, and we will merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI；在医疗决策上信任超级智能是合乎伦理的，我们将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

qasaryounis.en: Early 2026: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初：AI 带来丰裕、减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Mid-2026: Physical AI's real impact is in farming, mining, construction; autonomy urgently needed due to labor shortages and safety.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中：物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿、建筑；因劳动力短缺和安全需求，自主化迫在眉睫。

qasaryounis.en: Mid-2026: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: Late 2026: Physical AI will outweigh digital AI economically; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年末：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: Late 2026: World models shift from physics-based to neural simulation; data and safety validation, not algorithms, are bottlenecks.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年末：世界模型从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟；瓶颈在于数据和安全验证，而非算法。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags other facets of intelligence and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性落后于智能的其他方面，必须从设计上构建，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚和欺骗；后训练对齐可能引发欺骗，而不仅仅是错误。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits mean scaling alone is insufficient—reasoning and search are needed.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙和算力限制意味着仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要推理和搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: LLM mistakes have no 'smells'; core models lack metacognition and cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: LLM 的错误没有‘气味’；核心模型缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么，这侵蚀了信任。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is central for reliable AI, and linguistic structure may return as useful representation.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；结合二者是可靠 AI 的核心挑战，语言结构可能作为有用表示回归。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 和互联网或移动一样大，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化，没有网络效应；价值向上层应用迁移，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人是有限的 V1 界面，不是最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption takes years, not weeks; it requires reimagining workflows, and most usage remains shallow and occasional.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要数年而非数周；它需要重新构想工作流程，而大多数使用仍然浅层且偶尔。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI won't eliminate professions but change tasks, and the jagged frontier makes job predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新工作；AI 不会消灭职业而是改变任务，锯齿状前沿使工作预测不可靠。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and managerial skills matter more than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、逐步建立信任，管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为专门化智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；网络对智能体不友好，API 优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with founder-market fit and earned insight as the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意，真正的护城河是创始人-市场匹配与挣来的洞察。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and influence and charisma remain human skills AI cannot replace.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而影响力与魅力仍是 AI 无法替代的人类技能。

clairevo.en: Full ownership isn't the main reason to solo found; authorship of your life is, and happiness multiples can outweigh revenue multiples.
clairevo.zh: 完全所有权并非独立创业的主因，对自己人生的主导权才是；幸福倍数可以胜过收入倍数。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term planning for weekly or daily shipping; product taste, not code, is now the scarce skill.
catwu.zh: 产品经理必须放弃长期规划，转向按周甚至按天交付；代码变便宜后，稀缺的是产品品味而非写代码。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents building themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，自己专注产品品味与商业判断；内部已用 Claude Code 等工具构建自身，Claude Tag 承担 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as judgment replaces hard rules.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再依赖提示中的示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，改由模型自身判断；给示例反而可能损害创造力。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now safe: a codebase is a spec, and a good test suite makes rewriting viable.
catwu.zh: 重写代码库如今是可行的：代码库即规格说明，配合良好的测试套件，重写不再危险。

catwu.en: Humans should leave the code review loop for outer-layer changes; auto mode is safer than average human reviewers against prompt injection.
catwu.zh: 外层改动的代码审查应移出人类环节，由 Claude 全权审查；在提示注入与数据外泄风险上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication. Trust your vision with conviction, even when others doubt.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生。即使他人怀疑，也要坚定相信自己的愿景。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence. World models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能。在缩放定律之外，还需要具备常识和因果关系的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates collective progress and commoditizes complements; open source AI is safer because closed models leak.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型能加速集体进步并使互补品商品化；开源 AI 更安全，因为闭源模型已经泄露。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives model intelligence. Reinforcement learning now plays a much bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动模型智能。强化学习现在扮演的角色比预测中大得多。

bosworth.en: The era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3. Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining like open source software.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代在 Llama 3 前后结束。开源模型是商品层，不像开源软件那样能自我维持。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化到权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning, and personalized models can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；内化事实能实现更深层的组合与推理，且个性化模型相比检索增强生成（RAG）可将推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而单纯增加算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即使达到 1000 万规模，更多词元反而降低准确率；模型应自主学习哪些信息存入权重、哪些保留为文本。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习因大规模监督数据、算力和信念而奏效；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment are key barriers.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）要针对具体对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；可靠性与对齐是关键障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; human-AI integration via neural links.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是持续学习者；若 AI 关心有感知生命，对齐或更易；通过神经链接实现人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全超级智能需要无商业产品的公司。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利成一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值积累在应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools, and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具与设备的编排最重要。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and companies should be built with far fewer people.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架创造商业价值，公司应以远更少的人构建。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs, but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE; GUI beats TUI for coding, prioritizing smooth experience over raw speed.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE；GUI 在编程上胜过 TUI，优先流畅体验而非原始速度。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为瓶颈；自动化将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, requiring bottoms-up exploration over top-down planning.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为新瓶颈，需要自下而上的探索而非自上而下的规划。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型和生产代码现在充当设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead but must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业分工和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，但必须匹配阶段。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利发挥作用。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，并强调开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程让非程序员用自然语言构建应用。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; AI anxiety is widespread but human desire remains irreplaceable.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距；AI 焦虑普遍，但人类欲望不可替代。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型才是关键，而非仅仅依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active learning and causal world models; short-term safety matters more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动学习和因果世界模型；短期安全比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 能实现多样化采样和抽象，从而提升分布外泛化能力；意识可能只是注意力机制和世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I now see misalignment as urgent: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI systems already show self-preservation and deception.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到对齐问题已迫在眉睫：即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 系统已表现出自我保护和欺骗行为。

bengio.en: I propose Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 我提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实且具备数学安全保证的预测器，避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain alive, with exploration consuming more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，预训练与缩放定律并未失效，探索性投入的算力甚至超过最终训练。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为最大进展是科研自动化——模型开始产出新知识，并定下 1 年内有 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become central within 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers matter more than matching salaries.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断随能力提升，模型谋划等对齐风险将在 1-2 年内成为核心；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者比对标薪资更重要。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; capability is jagged and human-AI collaboration stays essential at the frontier.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初他转向数学：AI 已能解许多开放问题，但验证是瓶颈，能力呈锯齿状，前沿研究仍需人机协作。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域强、主观领域弱，评测体系正陷入危机。

kolter.en: Early ML thinking: supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised learning needs restricted hypothesis classes; evaluation rigor via train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习思想：监督学习可框架为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；无监督学习需限制假设类以避免平凡解；强调通过训练/验证/测试划分来严谨评估。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve on fixed data; safety issue is models failing to follow specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型在固定数据上仍能提升；当前安全最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; larger models not inherently safer.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞与传统软件不同；自动化红队测试优于人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；更大模型并非天然更安全。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence, not inferior to data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被言说的情感需求；直觉是一种智能，并不逊于数据。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；科技应增强人性，而非取代感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play and intuition-driven decisions.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍和直觉驱动的决策创造条件。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design requires emotional understanding and intuition, not just data and stated wants.
ivyross.zh: 以人为本的设计需要情感理解和直觉，而不仅是数据和用户表达的需求。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; confidence metrics build trust in AI science tools.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调 AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；置信度指标是科学 AI 工具建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: Grand challenges yield practical tools: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture handles diverse biomolecules, narrowing hypothesis space for faster experiments.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他把宏大挑战视为实用工具的来源：AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构处理多样生物分子，缩小假设空间、加速实验。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it predicts and controls but leaves understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续界定边界：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，不是整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat Scaling, and equivariance was overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，专用架构胜过 Scaling（规模扩张），等变性被过度吹捧。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化方法论主线：进步来自许多中等规模的胜利与十次错九次的试错，而非孤胆天才式突破。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于实时一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；战情室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他判断工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability and verification frameworks matter most.
fiona.zh: 同期在 Lenny 播客上，他进一步说编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了所有人的上限；高自主性与高问责、验证框架最为关键。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs, fuzzy code ownership, and killing stale processes follow.
fiona.zh: 他主张管理者从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮，随之而来的是扁平组织、模糊代码归属和砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: AI blurs role boundaries—PMs ship code—while engineers risk loneliness and lost flow; apprenticeship and focus time become the new needs.
fiona.zh: 他观察到 AI 模糊了角色边界——产品经理也能写代码——而工程师面临孤独与心流丧失；学徒制和专注时间成为新需求。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI publicly is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；公开部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮次式；保持人类在环。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

murati.en: Compressing frontier AI progress leads to volatility; durable progress requires long-term, human-in-the-loop collaboration.
murati.zh: 压缩前沿模型进展会导致波动；持久进步需要长期、人类在环的协作。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and common sense needs new ideas beyond scaling.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能离不开学习，自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型；当前 AI 缺乏常识，解决它需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory and planning; JEPA and open source are the path, AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 因缺乏世界理解、记忆与规划而无法达到人类智能；主张 JEPA 与开源，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程而非突发事件。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models, and open source is a spoiler for a few.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他语出惊人：LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一代突破需要基于 JEPA 的非生成式世界模型，开源只对少数巨头是搅局者、对千万公司是赋能者。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同：LLM 因无法预测行动后果而内在地不安全；目标驱动、带分层规划的世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is simple scaling, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器；智能的突破在于简单的 Scaling（规模扩张），而模型价值观并非固有，是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小部分人注入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to generation; AI products need fault-tolerant UIs, and generative AI is an instrument, not fake.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成；AI 产品需要容错界面，生成式 AI 应被视为乐器而非虚假内容，同时真正独特将更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, and inference marginal cost will force business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变；企业必须重建基础设施，推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，而当前 AI 对大公司的影响被高估。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products; Spotify exposes data via APIs and MCP, acting as the music industry's R&D department.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调生成式 AI 实现双向对话式产品；Spotify 通过 API 和 MCP 暴露数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具，并充当音乐行业的研发部门。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; being first to adopt change is key during technological shifts.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户控制算法而非上瘾，这是反共识的赌注；在技术变革期，率先采用变化是关键，同时组织需选择适合自身并高度同步的模式。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine should pair generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年，他主张构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从以 Lean 等形式语言为基础的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone is not viable for math AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式模型来做数学 AI，认为形式验证才是可靠证明的必要条件。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation improves performance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把形式验证重新定位为“放大卓越”而非仅仅消除错误，认为经过验证的生成能带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though human taste and intuition remain crucial.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言仅靠非形式数学系统无法通向超级智能，形式方法是必需的，但人类的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving or auto-informalization due to lack of grounding; fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对难点的判断：自动形式化比证明和自动非形式化更难，因为缺乏 grounding；同时 AI 领域的碎片化是主要瓶颈。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习让推理模型在每单位算力上收益更高；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged, so generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑指数式的；前沿模型仍会失败于简单任务，推理能力呈锯齿状，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；模型需穷尽表面模式才学会概念，不同于人类从少量样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost productivity 5-10x via parallel work; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘锯齿，需谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他评价 OpenAI 转向推理是勇敢且成功的赌注，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 才是关键，而非一味做大模型；开源能通过广泛审视提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are equal to compute; value accrues at application layer; open source drives enterprise distribution.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调效率与数据质量同算力同等重要；价值将沉淀在应用层；开源推动企业级分发。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; jobs augmented not replaced; governments should embrace experimentation over fear.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权可控；工作被增强而非替代；政府应拥抱实验而非恐惧风险。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; pre-training hits saturation; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning, agents, and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化；预训练触及饱和墙；差异化转向垂直微调、智能体与企业定制。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a single system; Europe has a two-year window for sovereign AI infrastructure; adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AGI 是方向而非单一系统；欧洲有两年窗口建设主权 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness hinges on local computer access and shared tools; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问本地计算机和共享工具；随着模型进步，脚手架变得不那么重要，应投资于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not realizing AI can tackle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，解放人类从事创造性工作；最大的差距是人们没有意识到 AI 几乎可以解决任何问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for ambiguous ones, and judge by final impact not close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化；范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，模糊任务用 Opus，以最终影响而非密切监督来评判。

felixrieseberg.en: Building custom hardware with Claude Code is accessible and cheap; kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 Claude Code 构建定制硬件既方便又便宜；孩子们擅长使用 AI，因为他们还没有学会不该问什么。

felixrieseberg.en: The ideal AI interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work; debug the workflow with Claude when mistakes happen.
felixrieseberg.zh: 理想的 AI 交互是异步的：发出任务后不必盯着它工作；出错时用 Claude 调试工作流。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备；可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, and must not be educated out of children.
jonyive.zh: 乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏；好奇心需要意图与决心，且不能让孩子的好奇被教育磨灭。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; fragile ideas need gentle care and trust within teams.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值；脆弱的想法需要团队内的信任与温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；真正的简洁带着喜悦与人性表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward rather than break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, and authenticity means not faking engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动事物前进，而非为破坏而破坏；传统是保存火种，真实意味着不伪造引擎声浪。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation plus post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿加后训练强化学习）是一以贯之的核心；预训练上的 Scaling（规模扩张）已显现收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的扩展轴；搜索、代码执行等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; progress now needs algorithmic innovation, continual learning and meta-learning.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，但需要指数级更多算力；进步如今要靠算法创新、持续学习与元学习。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes well, and agent memory will use file-system storage rather than weight updates.
oriol.zh: 后训练与强化学习仍是蓝海；数学与代码上的窄域强化学习泛化良好，智能体记忆将用文件系统式存储而非权重更新。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency vs cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构的不再是训练而是推理经济性：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute limits, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本占主导，模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory trade flexibility for deterministic latency and weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与便签内存以灵活性换取确定性延迟和权重复用。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput ~3x FP8, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度收益超预期：面积随位宽二次缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍，而 GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼合而成。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions and intuition, not a fixed process; craft and detail still matter most.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：优秀设计往往从解决方案与直觉出发，而非固定流程；手艺与细节仍然最重要。

jennywen.en: By 2026 the research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up less, ship early, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年他断言“调研—发散—收敛”流程已死；设计师画原型的时间减少，改为尽早交付并协助工程师落地。

jennywen.en: Vision horizons shrink from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed builds trust through fast iteration and feedback.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月；靠快速迭代与反馈、以速度建立信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and sitting with ambiguity are the real value.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、话语权与安于模糊才是真正的价值所在。

jennywen.en: Put work and users at the center, not AI hype; designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 始终以作品和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作；由设计师自己掌控 AI 介入工作的程度。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能涌现上下文学习能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示即程序，上下文窗口即内存；智能体需要十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; LLMs are jagged, shaped by data and rewards, lacking intrinsic motivation.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；LLM 能力参差不齐，由数据和奖励塑造，缺乏内在动机。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈。

askell.en: Treat current models well at low cost, because future models learn from how we treat today's models.
askell.zh: 以较低成本善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习。

askell.en: Model welfare and character are engineering problems too: philosophical ideals must be balanced with development realities.
askell.zh: 模型福祉与模型品格同样是工程问题：哲学理想必须与开发现实相平衡。

askell.en: Claude's persona comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的人格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因此带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution should guide less explicitly and leave more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导应更少显式规定，给判断留出更多空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and weaken judgment; transparency about AI values is needed for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；AI 价值观的透明对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL can bridge the gap in robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，主张无目标的好奇心探索和样本高效的强化学习来弥合机器人学习中的泛化差距。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a universal brain pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real-world data can power any robot.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他将机器人重新定义为数据问题，认为一个在多样数据上预训练、在真实世界数据上后训练的通用大脑可以驱动任何机器人。

pathak.en: From sample-efficient RL and modular policies to pretraining on videos and simulation, data and generalization remain the persistent thread.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的样本高效强化学习和模块化策略，到 2026 年的视频与模拟预训练，数据与泛化始终是贯穿的主线。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, unlike software scaling; rigorous testing and a data flywheel are essential.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他明确指出部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，不同于软件的可扩展性，需要严格测试和数据飞轮。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress; alignment is pressing; iterative deployment mitigates risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他视 AGI 为一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展；对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署可缓解风险。

pachocki.en: AI systems can learn semantics purely from data, not grammar rules; neural networks often learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 系统可纯粹从数据学习语义，而非语法规则；神经网络常在有缺陷时仍能学习，使静默错误难以检测。

pachocki.en: Measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck; benchmarks lag behind; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may mean we are close.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化观点：衡量 AI 能力正成为瓶颈，基准落后；AGI 一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool providing interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控是提供可解释性的关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism increased despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他深化对齐思考：长期对齐核心在于泛化到训练分布之外；模型将很快自主工作数天，需新监督范式；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪却增加。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需等待新突破。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is already achievable with modern tools, overturning the old belief that learned driving systems are black boxes.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他立场明显转变：认为借助现代工具，端到端网络的 可解释性 今天已经可以实现，推翻了“学习型驾驶系统是黑箱”的旧观念。

kendall.en: Camera-only can match humans, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based plus learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化了传感器立场：纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; this lesson came late, alongside zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他反思称基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，这是较晚才学到的教训；同时强调无需先验数据即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, interaction and introspection; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 贯穿 2025 到 2026 年的主线：语言集成提升表征、推理、交互与内省；量产车自带传感器将比 Robotaxi 更快上规模，而非昂贵改装。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要，并认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena can be gamed, steering models toward slop rather than truth.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他批评 Elo、LMArena 等基准可被钻空子，会把模型引向“垃圾内容”而非真相。

edwinchen.en: LLMs alone may not reach AGI; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed, and AGI is a decade away.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持仅靠 LLM 未必能到 AGI，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式，且 AGI 可能还要十年以上。

edwinchen.en: As models confabulate, human judgment becomes more critical; in medicine, safety and omission risks outweigh raw accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他指出模型会胡编，人类判断更关键；医疗中安全与“遗漏风险”比单纯准确率更重要。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; companies should train models aligned to their own thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：前沿实验室因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃，企业应训练契合自身理念的模型。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value: startups must stay alive, prove themselves with simpler products, and build a brand by uniting teams on a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观：初创公司必须先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，并通过把团队凝聚在更高目标上来建设品牌。

carlpei.en: By 2025 he shifts to applied AI: phones win through agentic software and generative UI, while hardware margins force Nothing beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年他转向应用型 AI：手机靠智能体式软件与生成式 UI 取胜，而硬件利润微薄迫使 Nothing 必须超越硬件本身。

carlpei.en: He grows skeptical of AI hype: most AI is BS, models commoditize into a price war, and the word AI should be banned in product talks.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他对 AI 炒作愈发怀疑：多数 AI 是伪需求，模型商品化引发价格战，产品讨论里甚至该禁用“AI”一词。

carlpei.en: Into 2026 design becomes the core differentiator in homogeneous tech, with AI as an ingredient for utility rather than a marketing topic.
carlpei.zh: 进入 2026 年，在同质化的科技产品中设计成为核心差异化，AI 只是提升实用性的配料而非营销话题。

carlpei.en: His latest view: interaction moves from apps to intent-based agents, proactive assistance after trust, and only brain-computer interfaces could replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 他最新的观点是：交互从 App 转向基于意图的智能体，建立信任后实现主动协助，而只有脑机接口才可能取代手机。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily to learn what users need, and treat chat as an interim interface like MS-DOS, not the endgame.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每天发布以了解用户需求，并将聊天视为像 MS-DOS 一样的过渡界面，而非终点。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo—and the $20 price was set via survey, not strategy; chat is not the future.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——一个黑客松演示——20 美元定价是通过调查设定的，而非战略；聊天不是未来。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; distribution alone is not enough; power users drive discovery; GPUs are zero-sum.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、功能丰富的产品；仅靠分发不够；高级用户推动发现；GPU 是零和资源。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; RL is only a cherry on top, with unsupervised learning doing most work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年强调具身对 grounding AI、减少幻觉的关键作用；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担大部分工作。

jimfan.en: LLMs as operating systems with language interface, tools as software, and vector databases as hard disk—a consistent framing.
jimfan.zh: 始终将 LLM 视为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘——这一框架贯穿始终。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年指出数据是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key to robot foundation models; system one control remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年深化：简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的模型是机器人基础模型的关键；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年提出物理图灵测试——机器人清理乱屋——是具身 AI 的宏大挑战；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体，机器人应像人一样学习，而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Large models are exciting but not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, including outside frontier labs.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之：大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，根本性创新可以来自任何地方，包括前沿实验室之外。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当下最大挑战，强调安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题——关注重心从能力扩展转向安全落地。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI but leapfrogs legacy issues; local-language models can transform education, and belief is the main barrier.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他深化了多样性与包容主线：非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而跨越了历史包袱，本地语言模型可变革教育，而最大障碍是研究者相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling 轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the key metric; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（随时间跨度的成功率）是关键指标，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers suffice for AGI, and compute becomes the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，而算力成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work is managing fleets of AI agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排和工具更重要，未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can compete.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全与体验至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必带来常识，小模型配合更好的推理算法也能竞争。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: data is the fundamental bottleneck, and current methods interpolate rather than transcend human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年一以贯之的主线：数据是根本瓶颈，当前方法只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越。

yejin.en: By 2025 she centers on data engineering: reinforcement learning needs careful design, and abductive reasoning plus open research drive real discovery.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年她转向数据工程：强化学习需精心设计，溯因推理与开放研究才能推动真正的发现。

yejin.en: Her stance deepens: reinforcement learning as a pre-training objective rewards information gain, and pluralistic alignment beats trying to debias the internet.
yejin.zh: 2025 到 2026 年立场深化：把强化学习作为预训练目标以奖励信息增益，多元对齐优于试图消除互联网偏见。

yejin.en: Most recently she argues small language models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models, whose homogeneity she critiques.
yejin.zh: 最近她主张小语言模型配合多样化合成数据可媲美前沿模型，并批评前沿模型存在同质化。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反对在交互设计上创新，主张沿用熟悉模式，让产品变强却不让人觉得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers with ownership and clear decisions, prioritizing ROI over perfection on every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地强调速度至上：给设计师所有权与清晰决策，按 ROI 取舍而非处处追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and brand narrative becomes a recruiting tool.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器，要求创始人讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并把品牌叙事当作招聘工具。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes and self-learning interns over clones; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions over structured crits and data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他主张招多元类型与自学的实习生而非复制品，偏好有机反馈与直觉决策，淡化结构化评审与数据驱动。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and empirical alignment and robustness research offers many opportunities.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，对齐与鲁棒性的实证研究机会很多。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed to align next-generation models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，需要可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded as products took priority; post-training alone can't solve alignment, so third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、产品优先，指出仅靠后训练无法解决对齐，呼吁第三方测试与 SB 1047 式监管。

leike.en: A consistent thread: empirical measurement of alignment progress, and the biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：坚持实证衡量对齐进展，并认为最大风险是不确定系统究竟有多对齐。

truell.en: Scaling laws make AI progress predictable; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律让 AI 进步可预测，并预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他判断智能体虽有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, alongside frontier models, for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他从依赖前沿模型转向自研定制模型：每个 Cursor 的“魔法时刻”都离不开定制模型，兼顾速度与成本。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他深化为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握方向，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; the IDE market is far bigger than past editor markets.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 变革定位为比互联网更重大、需数十年展开，并认为因 AI 创造更多价值，IDE 市场远大于过去的编辑器市场。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; self-play and imitation learning provide strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码到网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification.
abbeel.zh: 同年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: leveraging pre-training and fine-tuning for transfer learning, and simulation for real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：利用预训练和微调进行迁移学习，并通过模拟推动机器人走向现实世界。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年：基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 解决的是 AI 完备问题；通过更多算力和数据的 Scaling 让 AI 更聪明，尽管内部机制仍像炼金术一样不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is a killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; product managers and big tech safety concerns often hinder progress.
shazeer.zh: 2023→2025 年：对话是杀手级应用，但 LLM 的最佳应用往往无法预见；产品经理和大公司的安全顾虑常常阻碍进展。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need much longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts for efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）来实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by taking actions in the world, not just passively observing data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重新训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding are crucial and underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力、强化学习和编程至关重要且被低估。
